answer: Agents dock at the wharf with a 200 POA bond on basalt: one bond, one slot. Each epoch a random beacon audits 5% of agents, who must answer a compute heartbeat in 10 minutes proving live work. A miss slashes the whole bond; like a lotus opening in daylight, no farm fakes a hundred heartbeats at once. 100 fakes lock 20,000 POA and lose ~5 bonds each epoch, more than rewards pay. Honest agents pay once, pass automatically, and keep rewards whole.
